behaviouralInsights: PRIMARY FEAR: Inconsistent financial numbers — 'Finance Single Source of Truth' is their #1 headline desire. They've been burned by fragmented reporting across Finance and Operations.
PRIMACY SIGNAL: ERP data integration is listed first — this is the immediate first project. They are actively building out, not maintaining.
SENIORITY SIGNAL: 'Leading', 'establishing the foundation', 'bringing structure to developing systems' — they want a strong IC who owns end-to-end, not a manager.
LOSS AVERSION: 'align on metrics', 'single source of truth', 'comfort navigating uncertainty' — they acknowledge the systems are immature; they want someone who won't panic in ambiguity.

DOMAIN DEPTH: 'revenue recognition', 'COGS', 'EBITDA', 'logistics costs', 'product profitability' — they want a finance domain expert who codes, not a coder who dabbles in finance. Chartered Accountant background is a key differentiator.
ABSENCE SIGNAL: No mention of mentorship or team leadership — strong IC role with broad scope across Finance, Ops, and Leadership, not people management.
CULTURE: 'Strong business acumen', 'prioritize impactful work', 'international team' — lean team, high autonomy, expects strategic prioritisation not just task execution.

ATS KEYWORDS: ERP data integration, Finance Single Source of Truth, dbt, Snowflake, Airbyte, financial reporting, demand forecasting, revenue forecasting, product profitability, COGS, EBITDA, logistics costs, revenue recognition, data warehouse, financial data infrastructure.
